Name: Hollowstyx's Banties and Quail for AT
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
Hollowstyx's wonderful mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7046]Banties and Quail for Adopt 'n' Skin[/url] isn't compatible with Stardew 1.6 because Adopt 'n' Skin no longer works. Since the mod permissions allow asset use with credit, I've created an Alternative Textures pack so that these reskins can still be used! I've also added 2 recolors for the Golden Chicken, which didn't exist when the original mod was published.

To use this mod, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] and visit Robin's shop to buy the [b]Scissors[/b] tool. With the tool selected, click on any [b]Chicken[/b] (white, brown, blue, void, or golden) to see all available textures. In the AT interface, you can search for keywords such as Hollowstyx, bantam, rooster, quail, etc.

[b]CREDITS[/b]

All sprites were created by [b]Hollowstyx[/b], except for the 2 recolors I added for the Golden Chicken.

[b]MY OTHER MODS[/b]

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/NoraCharles/mods?gameId=1303]my other mods for Stardew Valley[/url], which include maps, animals, crops, furniture, clothing, and more!
All donation points earned by my mods go to [url=https://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/]Doctors Without Borders[/url].
